content_fields.title: Ensure automated and secure deployment (GitHub)
content_fields.description: Automate deployment so releases are reproducible and no person deploys by hand.
content_fields.guidance: Deployment should run from a reviewed pipeline against an immutable artifact, with environment approvals, automatic rollback and a recorded audit trail, rather than from a developer workstation.
content_fields.found: Deployment is a shell script that runs `docker compose up` on whatever host the operator is sitting at.
content_fields.missing: A deployment pipeline, target environment definitions and release approval gates.
content_fields.conclusion: Automating deployment requires CI/CD infrastructure and environment definitions that sit outside this repository.
content_fields.action: The CI/CD owners should build the deployment pipeline and retire manual script-based deployment.
